appearance.bark_look.thickness.note: The genus's bark thickness as its reference species', thuja-plicata (plantgen-claude project-files/bark/records/thuja-plicata.json): text: 10-25 mm (FNA); 'even on old trunks, is thin' (Sudworth); cap from the floras

appearance.bark_look.stages.young.note: The genus's young stage as its reference species, thuja-plicata, shows it (plantgen-claude project-files/bark/records/thuja-plicata.json): until_diameter_m: inferred (photo): no source gives where flat ridges turn rounded; fissures: text: 'distinctly but shallowly seamed, with narrow ridges which ... on younger trees flat' (Sudworth); exfoliation: text: 'separated into long, thin strips on younger trees' (Sudworth)

appearance.bark_look.stages.old.note: The genus's old stage as its reference species, thuja-plicata, shows it (plantgen-claude project-files/bark/records/thuja-plicata.json): fissures: text: 'in old trunks are rounded ... connected at short intervals by thinner diagonal ridges and fibers' (Sudworth); exfoliation: text: 'into shorter scales on old trunks' (Sudworth)

traits.note: Abrams (vol. 1, 1923, p. 71), Thuya (Thuja): scale leaves in crossing pairs on flattened sprays; pollen and seed cones on the same tree, the seed cone ripening in its first autumn.
